commit f67a187afd2cff31ed8d04929d544fa2f032f457

Klondike: seven tableau columns, four foundations, a three-card waste.
Upstream is a webpack/SCSS page with a card sprite and a Win95 chrome
frame. This port destacks to classic scripts, draws the cards in CSS
(the sprite is a placeholder in the repo), and keeps the tableau in the
file. Tap a face-up card to auto-move it; drag still works with a mouse
or a finger.
